data.description:
## Description

What: Extend the defense record shape in plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md and both defense-store writers (TrackerDefenseStore / GitHubPRDefenseStore) to include an OPTIONAL additive github_comment_id field, coordinated cross-epic with b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (swap-maple-flyby) whose arbiter writes defense entries. Existing/legacy records without the field remain valid. Why: the auto-resolve mechanism (draft-5) needs a comment-ID anchor and the current 11-field record shape has none. Scope IN: the contract doc update, the optional field on both defense-store writer paths, schema-compat tests proving legacy records still validate. Scope OUT: the thread-resolution mutation itself (draft-5); the arbiter's ruling logic (lives in b575).


## Done Definitions

- A defense record written with a github_comment_id round-trips through the defense store and exposes the field to readers; the field is documented in plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md as optional and additive ← Satisfies: sc-3
- A legacy defense record without github_comment_id still validates and is readable (non-breaking additive change) ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Both defense-store writers (tracker-backed and GitHub-PR-backed) accept and persist github_comment_id when supplied ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Cross-epic] This is a coordination requirement with b575-ac1c-f720-4839; the field must be additive/non-breaking so b575's arbiter writes and legacy records coexist. Coordinate the field name and type (github_comment_id, integer) with that epic's implementation sprint.
- [Contract] review-defenses.md is the source-of-truth contract; update it in the same change as the writer extension.
- [Cross-epic-field-lock] Lock the github_comment_id field name AND type with b575-ac1c-f720-4839 before implementation: confirm whether the stored id is the GitHub REST databaseId (integer) or the GraphQL node id (string). The defense-store dedup path and draft-5's resolveReviewThread thread-matching query MUST consume the same form — a REST-integer write paired with a GraphQL-node-id thread-match silently yields no matching thread (no-op resolution). Document the chosen form in review-defenses.md.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want the defense record schema to carry an optional github_comment_id field, so that auto-resolve can map a defense outcome to the GitHub thread it should resolve.
